name: contract-base
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.25 20n 0.25 20.02n 0.75 48n 0.75]
Vclk (vclk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 delay=0.25n period=1n width=0.35n rise=20p fall=20p
XDUT (vin vclk bitout) first_order_sigma_delta_modulator

tran tran stop=48n maxstep=2p strobeperiod=2p
save vin vclk bitout

name: contract-stretched-input
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.25 24.6n 0.25 24.6246n 0.75 59.04n 0.75]
Vclk (vclk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 delay=0.3075n period=1.23n width=0.4305n rise=20p fall=20p
XDUT (vin vclk bitout) first_order_sigma_delta_modulator

tran tran stop=59.04n maxstep=2p strobeperiod=2p
save vin vclk bitout
